description: Scroll inside an app at an element (element) or at a screenshot point (x and y); exactly one target. direction: up/down/left/right; pages: 0.1-20 (default 1 ≈ one visible page). Requires a prior observe_app for this app in this session. Observe again with observe_app to see the newly revealed content.

app.description: Target app: its name as listed by find_apps, its id (bundle id / executable name), or its absolute path.

direction.description: Direction to move the content view.

element.description: Element number: the #number from the latest observe_app output for this app.

x.description: X in pixels of the latest observe_app screenshot (origin top-left), exactly as seen in the image; the helper converts them to screen points (also for downscaled screenshots).

y.description: Y in pixels of the latest observe_app screenshot (origin top-left), exactly as seen in the image; the helper converts them to screen points (also for downscaled screenshots).

name: scroll_view
title: Scroll
